India ke kinare — abhi toofaan ka haal kya hai?

Sabse pehle woh baat jo is map ko imaandar banati hai: abhi koi cyclone sakriya nahi hai — isiliye ye map koi nakli toofaan ya nakli track nahi dikhata. Lekin samay sabse khatarnak wala hai: is archive ke 40 bade landfalls me se 26 Oct–Dec me hue hain, aur sabse zyada landfall wala mahina November (14) hai. Toh ye map dikhata hai ek taiyaari wala watch naksha: woh 7 coastal hisse jahan verified itihaas me sabse zyada toofaan takraye — ghumav (spiral) wale nishan, jitna bada ghumav utne zyada landfall. Kisi ghumav par tap karo — toofaan-badal khulega: us kinare ka itihaas, kya karein, route aur shelter tak escape route ke saath. View har 5 minute me dobara scan hota hai.

Ghumav (spiral) ka matlab — simple guide
◉Sabse bada gehra ghumav (10+ landfall) = India ka sabse zyada toofaan khane wala kinara (Andhra). DHYAAN DO — tap karo, toofaan-badal khulega.
◎Bada ghumav (5–9 landfall) = baar-baar bade toofaan takraye hain — Tamil Nadu, Odisha, Bengal Delta. DHYAAN DO.
○Madhyam ghumav (2–4 landfall) = kabhi-kabhi takrata hai — Gujarat, Maharashtra wala Arabian Sea kinara.
·Sabse chhota ghumav (1 landfall) = seedha landfall bahut kam — IGNORE kar sakte ho, bas peak season me chetaavni dekh lena.
Ye ghumav live toofaan NAHI hain — ye watch zone hain · asli live track sirf RSMC New Delhi deta hai · view har 5 min re-scan hota hai

Abhi ki sthiti — seedha sach

IMD ke 25 Oct 2026, subah 05:30 IST wale bulletin ke hisaab se Bay of Bengal me Depression BOB 08 hai — Visakhapatnam se lagbhag 880 km east-southeast (Sri Vijaya Puram se 440 km north-northwest). Abhi koi cyclonic storm sakriya nahi hai, lekin ye depression 26 Oct ki subah cyclonic storm ‘Arnab’, 27 Oct ko severe, aur 28 Oct ko Very Severe Cyclonic Storm bankar dopahar se pehle Bapatla–Visakhapatnam ke beech Andhra Pradesh–Yanam kinare ko paar kar sakta hai — hawa 115–125 km/h, jhonke 140 km/h tak. Tamil Nadu–Puducherry ke 9 bandargahon par warning signal lag chuke hain. Kinare ke log chetaavni ko turant gambhirta se lo — post-monsoon season apne PEAK par hai.

2026 season · imaandar note

2026 ka data — seedha sach

2026 me abhi tak (25 Oct 2026) North Indian Ocean me ek bhi cyclonic storm — naam wala toofaan — bana hi nahi. Poore saal ke system sirf depression ya deep depression rahe, isiliye is archive me 2026 ka koi record nahi hai — data gayab nahi hai, toofaan hi nahi bana. Do baatein khaas: (1) September 2026 ka deep depression BOB 06 Kalingapatnam ke paas takraya tha; cyclone na hone ke bawjud uski baarish aur baadh se India me kam se kam 100 log mare (Wikipedia ki 2026 season report ke anusar — Uttar Pradesh me kam se kam 81, Chhattisgarh 8, Odisha 2, Andhra Pradesh 9) — lekin ye archive sirf cyclonic storm aur usse bade toofaanon ka hai, isiliye woh yahan record nahi hai. (2) Abhi Bay of Bengal me Depression BOB 08 hai — IMD ke 25 Oct, subah 05:30 IST wale bulletin ke hisaab se ye Visakhapatnam se lagbhag 880 km east-southeast hai, 26 Oct ki subah cyclonic storm ‘Arnab’ ban sakta hai, aur 28 Oct ko Very Severe Cyclonic Storm (hawa 115–125 km/h, jhonke 140 km/h) bankar dopahar se pehle Bapatla–Visakhapatnam ke beech Andhra Pradesh–Yanam kinara paar kar sakta hai. Uska record yahan tabhi judega jab landfall ho jaye aur report verify ho jaye.

Ye ankde kahan se aaye — aur toofaan me kya karein

Sirf India ka toll — hamesha

Har record ki source usi ke page par linked hai. Jahan ek toofaan ne kai deshon me nuksaan kiya, yahan sirf Bharat ka ankda hai. Sabse mashoor misaal: Amphan (2020) ka kul ankda 128 kaha jata hai — usme Bangladesh 26 aur Sri Lanka 4 shamil hain; India ka toll 98 hai, aur yahi yahan milega. Waise hi 1988 ke toofaan me India ka 538 hai (kul 6,240 nahi), Hudhud me India ka 73 hai (Nepal ke 43 alag). Kuch mashoor naam jaan-boojh kar bahar hain kyunki Bharat me unka toll bahut kam ya zero tha — Dana 2024 (India me 1), Mocha 2023 (India me 0) — bheed badhane ke liye nakli entry nahi ghusayi gayi.

Category = toofaan ki peak class hai; kuch toofaan landfall tak kamzor pad chuke the — woh baat unke record me saaf likhi hai.

Season kab hota hai?

North Indian Ocean ka cyclone season do baar aata hai: pre-monsoon (Apr–Jun, peak May) aur post-monsoon (Oct–Dec, peak November). Is archive ke 40 landfalls me November me 14, May me 9 aur October me 8 hue. Isiliye October ke aakhir me “koi toofaan nahi” ka matlab “khatra nahi” bilkul nahi hai — yahi sabse zyada nazar rakhne wala samay hai.

Toofaan se pehle · beech me · baad me

Pehle: RSMC/IMD ki chetaavni roz dekho, phone charge rakho, kagazat aur dawaai waterproof bag me, cyclone shelter ka rasta pehle se jaan lo, machuaare samundar me bilkul na jayein.
Beech me: ghar ke sabse mazboot hisse me raho, khidkiyon se door, bijli-paani band karne ko taiyaar raho, kinare aur nadi-nalon ke paas bilkul na jao — storm surge sabse bada qaatil hota hai.
Baad me: tooti taaron aur behte paani se door raho, sarkari “all clear” ka intezaar karo, zakhmi ho toh turant hospital jao.
Emergency: 112 (sab emergency) · 101 par bhi madad ke liye sampark hota hai — asli khatre me intezaar mat karo, turant call karo.

Vayu — is site ka apna toofaan-bot

Neeche Vayu wala button dabao aur kuch bhi puchho: “Abhi koi cyclone hai kya?”, “Sabse bada cyclone kaunsa tha?”, “Amphan me kya hua tha?”, “29 Oct 1999 ko kya hua?”, “Cyclone se kaise bachein?”, ya “Paradip check karo”. Vayu kabhi nakli sakriya toofaan nahi kahegi, aur hamesha India wala hi toll degi. Type karke ya bol karke puchho.
